summary: Leeds Bradford controlled airspace deactivated and aerodrome closed, with no air traffic control; airspace reverts to Class G.
text:
LEEDS BRADFORD CTA, CTR, ATTZ DEACTIVATED, AD CLOSED, NO ATC
SERVICE AVAILABLE. LEEDS BRADFORD CONTROLLED AIRSPACE REVERTS
TO CLASS G. DURING PERIODS OF CLOSURE. SUITABLY EQUIPPED ACFT
WI LEEDS BRADFORD AIRSPACE DURING THESE PERIODS SHOULD MONITOR
LEEDS RADAR ON CH 134.580 AND SQUAWK EITHER 2677, ANY DISCRETE
TASK SPECIFIC CODE, OR ANY DISCRETE CODE ALLOCATED BY ANOTHER
UNIT. MET OBSERVATIONS UNVERIFIED DURING PERIODS OF CLOSURE.
